jobs.description:
Summary

Position Summary

ConvergeSports Data Engineer

ConvergeSPORTS (USI)

About The Role

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company.

Sports organizations generate enormous volumes of fan, ticketing, sponsorship, and commercial data, but it only creates value when it is trusted, connected, and ready to use. As a Data Engineer based in US-India (USI), you will build the data pipelines that turn raw sports data into production-grade foundations for ConvergeSPORTS products, powering analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled decision experiences. If you are an early-career engineer who wants to build real product infrastructure for the sports industry alongside experienced engineers, this is where you will do it.

Key Responsibilities

Build Data Pipelines

• Build and maintain batch data pipelines using SQL, Python, and PySpark to ingest, transform, and serve fan, sponsorship, ticketing, CRM, and commercial datasets
• Develop components of reusable ETL/ELT frameworks under the guidance of senior engineers, following established design patterns and coding standards
• Write, test, and tune SQL and Python code for correctness and performance, with unit tests and clear documentation

Make Data Trustworthy

• Implement data quality checks, validation routines, and lineage documentation that make data assets trustworthy for product use
• Contribute to data models and schemas that support analytics, machine learning, and agentic product features

Ship as One Team

• Partner with product managers and data scientists to translate defined requirements into production-ready data assets and feature pipelines
• Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of pipelines in production, working with application engineering and DevOps teams on CI/CD and observability
• Participate in Agile ceremonies and code reviews, and keep work items, estimates, and status current for USI and US stakeholders
• Help standardize data adapters and schemas across the ConvergeSPORTS product portfolio by documenting and reusing existing patterns

Reporting Relationships

Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with product management, data science, and application engineering, partners with US-based ConvergeSPORTS product and engineering leaders, and collaborates with DevOps and delivery teams across USI.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience
• 2-4 years of hands-on experience building and supporting data pipelines in product, platform, or data-intensive delivery environments
• Proficiency in SQL and Python, including writing, testing, and tuning data transformation code
• Experience with at least one cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or PostgreSQL
• Experience with Spark/PySpark or comparable distributed data processing frameworks, and with workflow orchestration
• Experience with Git/GitHub, branching, code review, and Agile product development
• Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders

Preferred

• Experience with sports, media, entertainment, sponsorship, ticketin

The Data Analyst will be a key contributor within the Data& Analytics team, responsible for designing and applying analytical techniques to solve business problems and support strategic decision-making. This role involves working with complex datasets, developing innovative solutions, and applying advanced computational methods to deliver actionable insights. The analyst will also play a critical role in testing and validating analytical models and ensuring alignment with business goals.

• Identify and scope business requirements and priorities through structured information gathering and analysis.

• Conduct statistical analysis and create visualizations to present findings in a clear, actionable manner
• Support ongoing monitoring of business performance through regular reporting and ad-hoc analysis.
• Develop test strategies and systematic procedures to validate solution performance and accuracy.
• Select and apply algorithms and advanced computational methods to enable systems to learn, adapt, and deliver desired outcomes.
• Approach problems with creativity and develop innovative, data-driven solutions.
• Challenge existing processes to drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

• Approach existing problems with fresh perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
• Challenge the status quo to drive continuous improvement and positive organizational impact.
• Demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through to achieve goals and objectives.

• Maintain awareness of how individual contributions align with the larger vision of the Bank.

What We Are Looking For

Education

• Graduation: B.Sc (Bachelor of Science) or B.Tech (Bachelor of Technology) or BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
• Post-Graduation: M.Sc (Master of Science), M.Tech (Master of Technology) or MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or MA Economics/Stats

Experience

• 2+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, algorithm development, and computational modeling.
• Exposure to business analytics and working with cross-functional teams.

Skills and Attributes

• Proficiency in analytical tools and techniques.
• Strong understanding of data structures and analytical frameworks.
• Ability to think innovatively and challenge conventional approaches.
• Strong drive to complete tasks and deliver results.
• Strategic mindset with an understanding of the broader business context.
• Ability to contribute meaningfully to the organization’s vision and goals.

Key Success Metrics

• Effective use of analytical tools.
• Quality and impact of business cases and data analyses delivered.

jobs.description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.



ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.



WHAT THIS ROLE PROMISES YOU

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.

 - Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.

 - Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.

 - Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.

 - Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.

 - Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.

 - Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.

 - Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.



WHO YOU ARE

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

 - You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.

 - You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.

 - You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.

 The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire-to-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.

Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience. 
 
 
  Talent Ecosystem Modernization:  Build data-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences. 
 
 
  Delivery Lead Partnership:  Partner closely with the Growth & Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.

Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long-term scalability. 
 
 
  AI & Talent Automation Strategy:  Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human-in-the-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Product UI and Design)
jobs.description:
About Lexsi Labs

Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab working toward aligned, interpretable and safe superintelligent systems. Our near-term mission is to build safety-aware autonomous systems for mission-critical settings such as banking, insurance, government and healthcare. We believe the institutions that deploy AI should be able to audit, correct and own the risk of the models they rely on, and we build the research and the platform that make that possible.

Our research spans AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundation model research across language, structured and tabular data, and autonomous systems. We have published 25+ papers in the past 15 months across conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris and London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behaviour.

About the Role

We are building the platform through which institutions own the AI they depend on. Post-training, alignment, evaluation, deployment and monitoring run inside the customer’s own environment, on the methods our labs publish.

The people using it vary widely. Post-training scientists and AI researchers run experiments at the edge of what current methods can do. AI and ML engineers take models and agents into production. Data scientists build and validate models on enterprise data. Platform and infrastructure teams operate the compute and services underneath. Inside banks, insurers and public institutions, model risk, validation and audit teams need to understand and sign off on results without writing code, and business owners need to see what is running and how it is performing. The same screen often has to serve a researcher and a risk reviewer.

The interface decides whether frontier model science stays in research papers or becomes something every institution can operate.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write production React and TypeScript most of the week, own the frontend architecture of the platform, and make the final call on its flows, information architecture and visual design. You will work with a product designer and one or two frontend engineers, setting the standard through code and review rather than management. Expect roughly 70% of your time on building and 30% on design decisions, review and direction.

What you’ll work on
• Own the frontend architecture of a large React and TypeScript application: routing and layout, code splitting, state boundaries, and the contracts between the UI and backend services.
• Own the component library and design tokens as a single system used across the application, evolving it incrementally in a live codebase without pausing feature work.
• Design and build data-dense interfaces: virtualised tables over large result sets, live metrics and log streams, trace and graph visualisations, side-by-side comparisons, and code and configuration editors.
• Build a real-time data layer over SSE and WebSockets with reconnection, backpressure and cache semantics that stay consistent with request-response queries.
• Build schema-driven form systems for deeply nested, conditional configuration, validated against backend schemas.
• Design interfaces that work for users with very different levels of technical depth, from researchers to risk reviewers, without splitting the product

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - PAM
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human   Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.   Principal Software Engineer - PAM 
   
 Okta is the identity standard. The Okta Identity Cloud is an independent and neutral platform that securely connects the right people to the right technologies at the right time. We help organizations do two things - secure and manage their extended enterprise, and transform their customers' experiences. With over 14,000 customers, 7000+ app integrations, and well over 200 million registered users, we are only getting started. 
   
 The Okta Privileged Access Management (PAM) is an identity-centric approach to a common and critical privileged access use case. Our elegant Zero Trust architecture is purpose-built for the modern cloud and helps customers solve challenging security and operations pain points at scale. 
   
 We're looking for a staff-level fullstack engineer to join a team of highly skilled and talented team players who're proud of what they own and deliver. Our elite team is fast, creative, and flexible; with a weekly release cycle and individual ownership, we expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies, and the chance to have significant equity in a company that is changing the cloud computing landscape forever.

And we're only getting started. 
 You will work with your team to  build infrastructure and products for the Databricks platform at scale . We have multiple teams working on different domains. 
 
 Resource management infrastructure powering the big data and machine learning workloads on the Databricks platform in a scalable, secure, and cloud-agnostic way 
 Develop reliable, scalable services and client libraries that work with massive amounts of data on the cloud, across geographic regions and Cloud providers 
 Build tools to allow Databricks engineers to operate their services across different clouds and environments

 Hire great engineers to build an outstanding team.

 Ensure  high technical standards  by instituting processes (architecture reviews, testing) and culture (engineering excellence). 
 Work with engineering and product leadership to build a long-term roadmap.

  What we look for:  
 
  12+ years  of extensive  experience with large-scale distributed systems  alongside the processes around testing, monitoring, SLAs etc 
 Extensive experience as a  Software Engineering Leader  ,  building & scaling software engineering teams  from ground up

jobs.description:

Lakeflow Connect is looking to solve this problem by providing ready-to-use, point-and-click connectors for a wide variety of sources, including enterprise applications (like Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint), databases (e.g., SQL Server), cloud storage, message queues, and local files.

 We are looking for engineers with experience in core Database internals to join our Lakeflow Connect team. A key part of Connect is to extract data from OLTP systems while imposing minimal load on production systems. To do this efficiently we are building systems that use techniques such as incremental data capture, log parsing, etc. We are looking for engineers who continue to be hands on and are looking to make a large impact on an important problem for the company.

 Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering.

 Plan and lead complicated technical projects that work with several teams within the company. 
 Break down complex problems quickly into potential solutions, knowns, and unknowns, and de-risk (through prototyping/validation).

 BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field

jobs.description:

We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in  Bengaluru , India  ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale. 
  About the Team  
 We manage the infrastructure efficiency for one of the world's largest data and AI platforms. Operating at massive scale across AWS, Azure, and GCP, our mission is to ensure that every dollar spent on cloud infrastructure is optimized. The MCE team builds the critical tools, frameworks, and automated systems that provide deep cost visibility and ensure maximum resource utilization. We are looking for engineers to help us engineer systems that optimize our footprint as we scale into the hundreds of millions of dollars in cloud spend.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Framework Integrations
jobs.description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members. 
 The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. 
 This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires. 
 You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities. 
 MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day — we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 
 Position expectations 
 
 Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance. 
 Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve.

 Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles. 
 Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness.

GAQ126R44  
 About Databricks 
 At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. 
 We're looking for a SAP Developer to build the applications, extensions, and integrations that bring this vision to life. In this role,  you'll write clean-core extensions on SAP BTP, build full-stack apps and Fiori experiences, wire up integrations between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, and help embed AI and agentic capabilities directly into finance workflows.  You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI—shipping software that makes finance operations faster, smarter, and more automated. 
 The Opportunity 
 SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As an SAP Developer, you'll be hands-on-keyboard building the layer that makes those processes intelligent: side-by-side extensions on BTP, event-driven integrations into the Lakehouse, and AI-assisted workflows that automate routine work and guide users through exceptions and approvals. You'll build with modern SAP and Databricks AI tooling—combining SAP’s core ERP capabilities with Databricks-native AI, agentic applications, and automation—while keeping the SAP digital core clean, scalable, and upgradable. Your mission is to turn designs into robust, production-grade software that combines the strength of SAP with the power of Databricks AI. 
 What You'll Do 
 
  Build Clean-Core Extensions:  Develop in-app and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP that keep the S/4HANA digital core clean and upgrade-ready, using released APIs and extension points rather than core modifications. 
  Develop Databricks-Native Applications:  Build scalable, full-stack applications and services on the Databricks platform that extend and integrate with SAP, leveraging Databricks-native capabilities, APIs, data services, and AI/agentic tooling to deliver modern Finance experiences while keeping the SAP core clean. 
  Build Integrations:  Implement secure, resilient integrations across SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP Integration Suite, event-driven patterns, APIs, OData v4, and change-data feeds into the Databricks Lakehouse, with solid error handling and monitoring. 
  Embed AI & Agentic Capabilities:  Build AI-powered and agentic capabilities into Finance workflows using Databricks AI, integrating seamlessly with SAP and other enterprise systems. Apply RAG, prompt engineering, tool calling, and human-in-the-loop controls to automate processes safely while maintaining governance and auditability

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human   Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.    About the Team   
 Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0  FGA  solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a    CNCF    incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0  FGA  runs that same engine as a managed service. 
  FGA  DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The  FGA  group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers. 
 Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models. 
  About the role   
 We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like    MCP    servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language. 
 This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery 
  Responsibilities  
  Set the direction:  
 
 Define and drive the technical direction for  FGA  DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team. 
 Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community  
 Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you. 
 Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar. 
 Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate. 
 Be the voice of developer experience across  FGA : partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it. 
 
  Own the Platform:   
 
 Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from. 
 Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting. 
 Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples. 
 Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions  
 Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.

 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direc

 Commvault does  not  conduct interviews by email or text.

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns — they are part of the product ..

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us.

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations.

jobs.description:
Location : Bangalore/Pune About Team & About Role:   
  As a Senior Software Engineer (SSE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org. 
 You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Responsibilities    
 
 Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems. 
 Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. 
 Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. 
 Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. 
 Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. 
 Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. 
 Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. 
 Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.). 
 Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature. 
 Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status. 
 
   Requirements    Must-have  
 
 Minimum experience of at least 8 Years 
 Strong hands-on programming skills in  Golang . 
 Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols:  OIDC/OAuth 2.0  and  SAML 2.0  — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes. 
 Working knowledge of  Active Directory . 
 Applied cryptography/PKI experience:  X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS . 
 Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work. 
 Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.

jobs.description:
About the team   
  The Polaris Platform Bangalore team (a.k.a. Legion team) at Rubrik provides the core platforms and systems that enable product engineers to efficiently build and operate scalable and reliable applications in the cloud and also the on-prem version of the control plane. Polaris Platform has a horizontal charter with our customers being both external customers as well as Rubrik internal teams. Presently, the Legion team is working on enabling product led trials, license management & enforcement, making  its cloud deployment infrastructure more efficient. Legion team also owns the on-prem RSC (RSC-P) version and is currently working on supporting it on different deployments, while ensuring it scales and is performant like its cloud counterpart.   
   About the role   
  We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team. We believe in giving engineers responsibility, not tasks. Our goal is to motivate and challenge people to do their best work. To do that, we have a very fluid structure and give people flexibility to work on projects that they enjoy the most. This develops more capable engineers, and keeps everyone engaged and happy. To address challenges of huge year over year growth, our team is constantly re-imagining our platform. This is an exciting time to join as we are constantly improving and innovating on each of our core layers.  
  Some recent projects include:  
 
  Enabling product assisted trials to decrease sales cycles  
  Bringing in Licensing visibility and enforcement for customers  
  Scaling our single node on-prem control plane (RSC-P) to multi node  
  Bringing in deployment efficiency to improve developer productivity  
 
   What you’ll do   
 
  Build our platforms, systems and infrastructure using your strong background in distributed systems and large scale storage systems.  
  Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve the software.  
  Manage individual projects priorities, deadlines and deliverables with your technical expertise.  
 
   Experience and qualifications you’ll need   
 
  Rubrik Software Engineers are self-starters, driven, and can manage themselves. Bottom line,if you have a limitless drive and like to win, we want to talk to you - come make history!  
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science or related field  
    6 months - 1 year of total work experience    
  Proficiency in one or more general purpose programming languages like Java, C/C++, Scala, Python, C#. Having prior experience with C++ would be a plus.   
  Experience with Google Cloud Platform/AWS/Azure or other public cloud technologies is a plus  
  Experience working with two or more from the following: Unix/Linux environments, Windows environments, distributed systems, networking, developing large software systems, file systems, storage systems, hypervisors, databases and/or security software development.  
  Knowledge of Docker, Containers, Kubernetes, microservice architectures is a plus.  
 
   
   
   
   
   
     Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation 
 Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI age

 Commvault does  not  conduct interviews by email or text. 
 We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day. 
 Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee. 
 
 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at   wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com    
   
  About Commvault   
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. jobs.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

10

S&P Global Dow Jones Indices

The Role: Senior Software Engineer (.Net with Java)

S&P Dow Jones Indices a global leader in providing investable and benchmark indices to the financial markets, is looking for a Senior Lead Application Developer to join our technology team.

The Team: You will be part of global technology team comprising of Dev, QA and BA teams and will be responsible for analysis, design, development and testing.

The Impact: You will be working on one of the core technology platforms responsible for index calculations as well as dissemination of index values

What’s in it for you: You will have the opportunity to work on the enhancements to the existing index calculation system as well as implement new methodologies as required

Responsibilities

Modernization strategy (from .NET MVC to cloud-native)

Assess current .NET/C#/MVC applications (dependencies, coupling, data access patterns, hosting, performance bottlenecks, security gaps).

Define modernization approach per capability: rehost/refactor/re-architect/replace, prioritizing quick wins and risk reduction.

AWS cloud-native implementation

Design and guide build-out of cloud foundations required for modern apps (networking, environments, security, observability, CI/CD).

Ensure production readiness: performance testing strategy, failure-mode testing, rollout/rollback procedures.

Migration to existing AWS/Java (Spring/Hibernate) platforms

Lead functional migration from .NET code paths to Java-based services while maintaining correctness and availability.

Define interoperability approach during transition (API contracts, adapters, strangler pattern, feature toggles, compatibility layers).

Partner with platform owners to ensure migrated components comply with existing Java platform conventions and deployment pipelines.

Engineering excellence & SDLC

Set standards for clean code, code reviews, test automation, branching/release strategy, and environment promotion.

Drive test strategy across stacks: unit, contract, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests; improve automation coverage.

Improve build/release reliability; reduce cycle time; implement guardrails (quality gates, vulnerability scanning as applicable).

Security, compliance, and risk management

Embed secure engineering practices (threat modelling participation, secure coding standards, dependency hygiene).

Ensure appropriate handling of secrets/credentials, least-privilege access, and auditability.

Identify technical risks early (data migration risk, downtime, coupling, unknown dependencies) and drive mitigation plans.
